seat: A person asking what Magna Carta (1297) secures them, on the parts of its text that show no repeal annotation: whether the Church of England is free (c. 1), whether the City of London and other cities, boroughs, towns and the Barons of the Five Ports keep their liberties and free customs (c. 9), whether they may be taken, imprisoned, disseised, outlawed, exiled or in any way destroyed, or have the King proceed against or condemn them, other than by lawful judgment of their peers or by the law of the land, and whether justice or right may be sold, denied or deferred (c. 29), and what the saving paragraphs promise about the observance of the liberties.
